page.overview:
Who is Clock Titans?

The Clock Titans are a pair of deities that are in charge of the line of space and time. Prismo mentions that they are probably not alive.

The clock titans are large constructs holding hammers. One of them has a face shaped like a clock with a long nose in the place of its hands, with a blue tint. The other resembles an hourglass with arms and has an orange tint.
